description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseClusterEntity' in the Orleans clustering system for Cosmos DB integration. It includes properties for cluster identification and entity type, serving as a base for other cluster entity classes.

classes.name: BaseClusterEntity
classes.description: An abstract class representing a base cluster entity with cluster ID and entity type properties, intended to be inherited by specific entity implementations.

methods.name: EntityType
methods.description: An abstract property that should be overridden in derived classes to specify the entity's type.
